scheme_name: Accidental Death Assistance Scheme- Gujarat Labour Welfare Board
description:
The Accidental Death Assistance Scheme is a welfare initiative launched by the Gujarat Labour Welfare Board. 

This scheme was officially launched on 1st April 2017. 

It was introduced to provide financial assistance to the families of workers who suffer accidental deaths. 

The primary objective of this scheme is to offer immediate financial relief to the dependents of deceased workers. 

The scheme aims to ensure that families do not face financial hardships due to the sudden loss of their breadwinner. 

The assistance provided under this scheme is specifically targeted towards unorganized sector workers. 

The financial assistance amount is set at ₹2 lakh for the family of the deceased worker. 

This amount is intended to help cover immediate expenses and provide some financial security to the family. 

The scheme is applicable to workers who are registered under the Gujarat Labour Welfare Board. 

To be eligible for this scheme, the worker must have been engaged in a job that falls under the unorganized sector. 

The worker must also have been a resident of Gujarat at the time of the accident. 

There are no specific age limits for eligibility under this scheme. 

However, the worker must have been actively employed and contributing to the welfare fund. 

The application process for the Accidental Death Assistance Scheme is straightforward. 

The family members of the deceased worker must submit an application to the Gujarat Labour Welfare Board. 

The application must include a copy of the death certificate of the worker. 

Additionally, the application should contain proof of the worker's employment and registration under the welfare board. 

Documents such as identity proof and bank account details of the beneficiary must also be submitted. 

The application can be submitted online through the official website of the Gujarat Labour Welfare Board. 

Alternatively, it can also be submitted in person at the nearest Labour Welfare Office. 

Once the application is received, it is processed by the concerned authorities. 

The processing time for the application is typically around 30 days. 

Upon approval, the financial assistance amount is disbursed directly to the bank account of the beneficiary. 

The scheme is designed to provide assistance on a one-time basis for each accidental death. 

The Gujarat Labour Welfare Board is responsible for the implementation of this scheme. 

The board operates under the Department of Labour and Employment, Government of Gujarat. 

For any queries or assistance regarding the scheme, individuals can contact the Gujarat Labour Welfare Board. 

The contact details for the board can be found on their official website. 

The board also conducts awareness programs to inform workers about the benefits of this scheme. 

As of 2023, the scheme has benefited thousands of families across Gujarat. 

The financial assistance provided has been crucial in helping families cope with the loss of their loved ones. 

The scheme is part of the broader efforts by the Government of Gujarat to enhance the welfare of workers. 

The government recognizes the vulnerabilities faced by workers in the unorganized sector. 

This scheme is one of several initiatives aimed at providing social security to these workers. 

The Accidental Death Assistance Scheme has been well-received by the public. 

It has been praised for its timely assistance and support to grieving families. 

The scheme is regularly reviewed to ensure its effectiveness and reach. 

The government aims to increase awareness and participation in the scheme. 

Efforts are being made to streamline the application process further. 

This includes enhancing online services for easier access to the scheme. 

The Gujarat Labour Welfare Board is committed to ensuring that no family suffers due to a lack of financial support. 

The scheme reflects the government's commitment to worker welfare and social security. 

In conclusion, the Accidental Death Assistance Scheme is a vital initiative for the welfare of workers in Gujarat. 

It provides essential financial support to families in their time of need. 

The scheme is a testament to the government's dedication to improving the lives of its citizens. 

The financial assistance of ₹2 lakh can significantly alleviate the burden on families. 

It is crucial for families to understand the eligibility criteria and application process. 

Awareness about the scheme can lead to more families benefiting from this support. 

The Gujarat Labour Welfare Board continues to work towards better implementation of the scheme. 

They aim to ensure that all eligible families receive the assistance they need promptly. 

The scheme is an important step towards providing social security for unorganized sector workers in Gujarat. 

Overall, the Accidental Death Assistance Scheme is a commendable effort by the Government of Gujarat. 

It addresses a critical need for financial support in the event of accidental deaths. 

The scheme is a lifeline for many families who rely on the income of a single breadwinner. 

The government continues to monitor and improve the scheme for better outreach and impact. 

This initiative is a part of a larger framework of welfare schemes aimed at enhancing the quality of life for workers in Gujarat. 

The Accidental Death Assistance Scheme stands as a model for similar initiatives across other states in India. 

It highlights the importance of providing timely assistance to those in need. 

The scheme is a reflection of the government's commitment to social justice and worker welfare.
